title: Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA Sample Prep: Part 1 of 3: mRNA Isolation and cDNA Synthesis
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑bead mixture
steps.instruction: Combine water, the input total RNA (8–48 samples) and oligo‑dT magnetic beads in a tube, then denature the mixture and allow the poly(A) RNA to bind to the beads, following the Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA LT kit (LS protocol, pages 12‑44).

substeps.instruction: Add the specified volume of water to the tube
Denature the mixture (heat as instructed in the kit)
Incubate to permit RNA binding to the beads

steps.title: Pellet and wash beads
steps.instruction: Magnetically pellet the RNA‑bound beads, wash them, and elute the captured RNA.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack until beads collect on the side
Add wash buffer and resuspend beads
Repeat washing as required by the kit
Elute the bound RNA from the beads with the elution buffer

steps.title: Rebind beads and synthesize first cDNA
steps.instruction: Re‑bind the eluted RNA to fresh oligo‑dT beads, perform a second elution that includes fragmentation, add priming reagents, and carry out first‑strand cDNA synthesis.

substeps.instruction: Add fresh oligo‑dT magnetic beads to the eluate and allow rebinding
Elute the RNA with fragmentation buffer
Add the priming mix to the fragmented RNA
Run the first‑strand cDNA synthesis reaction according to kit instructions

steps.title: Second‑strand synthesis and cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform second‑strand synthesis incorporating dUTP, then clean up the double‑stranded cDNA using Ampure XP magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Set up the second‑strand synthesis reaction with dUTP as specified
Incubate for the required time and temperature
Add Ampure XP magnetic beads to the reaction for purification
Wash the beads, then elute the final cDNA library
